7346.title: Plugin wait ownership is replaced by hook order
7346.rootCauseOneLine: Dispatch chooses the first registered wait without preserving the queued holder or submitting plugin.
7346.proposedFix: Prefer the durable holder or submitting plugin when it still waits; otherwise keep first-wait fallback and retain every additional waiter.
7346.caveats: Unregister/orphan consequences are source-traced, not separately live-reproduced. The wrong stored UI reason is tested without a browser.
